  • Collaboration: Works well across the hardware, ASIC and software boundaries rather than only inside the FPGA.
  • Ownership: Takes a problem from architecture through to a working system, and sees it through.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment where the requirement can move.

Success Indicators:

  • Firmware that meets timing and functions correctly on first hardware more often than not, with issues found in simulation rather than on the bench.
  • Effective bring-up and debugging support during prototype validation and customer deployment, with hardware and firmware issues resolved promptly.
  • Design documentation, simulation coverage and design review contributions good enough for another engineer to maintain the work.

Benefits of Joining Singular Photonics
